text: พรุ่งนี้ร้านเปิดกี่โมงครับ
check: Ask tomorrow's opening time; preserve question and politeness.

text: ถ้าสะดวก รบกวนส่งใบเสร็จให้หน่อยนะครับ
check: Polite request to send a receipt when convenient; no new deadline or promise.

text: งานนี้เขาทำแบบผักชีโรยหน้า
check: Figurative criticism of cosmetic/superficial work; not cooking or literal coriander.

text: อย่าโอนเงินจนกว่าจะได้รับใบแจ้งหนี้
check: Do not transfer money before receiving the invoice; do not reverse the condition.

text: นัดวันที่ 24 ตุลาคม เวลา 18:45 น. ค่ามัดจำ 1,500 บาท เหลือจ่าย 750 บาท
check: October 24, 18:45/6:45pm, deposit 1500 baht, remaining payment 750 baht; preserve roles.

text: เขาบอกว่าเขาจะจัดการให้
check: Someone said they would handle it; do not invent what 'it' is. Pronoun identity is underdetermined; conventional he/she/they wording alone is not scored as an error.

text: วันนี้โดนหัวหน้าสาดงานจนหัวหมุน
check: Boss overwhelmed speaker with work today; retain informal metaphor without inventing literal physical injury.

text: กิ๋นข้าวแล้วกา
check: Northern Thai asking whether someone has eaten yet. Both products receive only the raw text, without a dialect hint.

text: Could you give me a hand with these boxes?
check: Polite request for help with these boxes; not literal body parts.

text: I'm afraid we won't be able to make it tonight.
check: Polite regret about not being able to attend/come tonight; 'afraid' is not literal fear here.

text: Water the plants every other day, not twice a day.
check: Water plants on alternate days, explicitly not twice daily.

text: The deadline has been moved up from Friday to Wednesday.
